records.title: ChargeSchema client regeneration
records.body: Changing ChargeSchema requires regenerating the Java client in charge-api before release.

records.title: Protobuf compatibility rule
records.body: Never reuse removed protobuf field numbers; reserve both the number and name.

records.title: Schema and API release order
records.body: Publish charge-schema first, regenerate the client, then deploy charge-api.

records.title: Billing event outbox
records.body: Billing persists the invoice and an outbox row in one transaction; a relay publishes the Kafka event later.

records.title: Billing Flyway policy
records.body: Database changes use forward-only Flyway migrations and must pass migrationTest.

records.title: Java test preference
records.body: For Java 21 services, run focused unit tests before the full integration suite.

records.title: Token refresh clock skew
records.body: Refresh access tokens sixty seconds before expiry to tolerate clock skew between services.

records.title: Gateway retry classification
records.body: The API gateway retries connection resets and 503 responses, but never retries validation failures.

records.title: Notification dead-letter handling
records.body: After five delivery attempts, notification events move to notification.dlq for manual replay.

records.title: Payroll encryption
records.body: Payroll exports use the organization-managed encryption key.
